verdict.rationale: Vercel ships an official CLI (vercel-docs-4/vercel-gh-1, vercel-probe-4, vercel-gh-2) that supports git push-based and CLI-driven deploys usable in CI pipelines, plus REST/OpenAPI API access (vercel-probe-3) for scripted automation, and CI-friendly features like environment variable management and rollback/promote commands (vercel-docs-23, vercel-docs-29). Missing for 10: no explicit GitHub Actions/CI recipe documentation or independent hands-on report of running the CLI fully headlessly in a third-party CI system.
